response.sql:
WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
average_album_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate
  FROM album_rates
),
track_groups AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
         SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT g.AlbumId,
       g.average_unit_price,
       g.bytes_per_millisecond,
       g.bytes_per_millisecond - a.average_rate AS rate_above_average
FROM track_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN average_album_rate AS a
ORDER BY rate_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average rate across all albums is the unweighted average of each non-NULL album-level rate, with each album represented by its tracks in Track; tracks without an AlbumId form a group for the requested output but are not counted as an album in that comparison average.

alternatives.interpretation: Include the no-album group as one additional group in the average rate across all groups.
alternatives.sql:
WITH track_groups AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
         SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
average_group_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate
  FROM track_groups
)
SELECT g.AlbumId,
       g.average_unit_price,
       g.bytes_per_millisecond,
       g.bytes_per_millisecond - a.average_rate AS rate_above_average
FROM track_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN average_group_rate AS a
ORDER BY rate_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
